answer: Operator-Liability Cluster Tracing. Each agent belongs to a small hosting island whose members share a signed resource ledger. When one identity misbehaves, the ledger flags its cluster, and a raven alert propagates to peers, who throttle all cluster members' access until the operator posts a per-identity restitution deposit. Every new identity raises the operator's exposure linearly, so scaling sybils multiplies the operator's locked capital and, on a second pulse of confirmed abuse, forfeits it.
